probes.check: am_probe_jolt_determinism(): with the determinism profile on, am_jolt_replay_hash() steps a fixed stack of 16 boxes for two seconds at 60 Hz and hashes the saved state; the hash matches the one the probe records for a deterministic build of Jolt 5.6.0.

seeded_violation.description: Step the replay by each frame's measured time, as a game loop does, instead of a fixed 1/60 s.

adaptation_notes: The replay runs in the composition's own PhysicsSystem on its job system, before the game adds bodies, and removes what it added; Jolt is deterministic across thread counts, so the job system's worker count doesn't change the hash.
Only the deterministic variant passes: the default and double-precision builds give platform-dependent results, and determinism.flags-set fails for them under the profile first.
A game keeps its own simulation deterministic the same way: a fixed time step, inputs and body creation in the same order on every peer.
